    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    df_print: paged

<!--
One-off EDA of the existing Productboard note ("insight") corpus, ahead of
designing a structured format for CSMs to log substantive delivery
requirements. Not part of the pipeline.

Run order:
  1. devtools::load_all() from the project root.
  2. pb_pull_insights()   # once — caches data/productboard/pb_insights_<date>.rds
  3. Knit this file (it loads the newest cache; set PULL_FRESH <- TRUE to re-pull).
Requires PRODUCTBOARD_API_TOKEN in .Renviron for step 2.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

PROJ           <- normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."))
PULL_FRESH     <- FALSE
CUSTOMERS_ONLY <- TRUE    # only notes tied to an account in op_list$accounts
TODAY          <- Sys.Date()

devtools::load_all(PROJ, quiet = TRUE)

pb <- if (PULL_FRESH) pb_pull_insights(cache_dir = file.path(PROJ, "data", "productboard")) else
        pb_load_insights(file.path(PROJ, "data", "productboard"))

# Latest pipeline snapshot, for account context (ARR, CSM, adoption rating).
snaps <- list.files(file.path(PROJ, "data"), pattern = "^opportunities_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
load(sort(snaps, decreasing = TRUE)[1])   # -> op_list
accts <- op_list$accounts
N_ALL <- nrow(pb$notes)
pb    <- pb_match_accounts(pb, accts, customers_only = CUSTOMERS_ONLY)

notes <- pb$notes %>%
  mutate(
    created_date = as.Date(created_at),
    fq           = ifelse(is.na(created_date), NA_character_, date_to_fiscal_quarter(created_date)),
    n_words      = ifelse(is.na(content_text), 0L, lengths(strsplit(trimws(content_text), "\\s+"))),
    has_customer = !is.na(customer_id),
    has_company  = !is.na(company_id),
    has_account  = !is.na(account_name)
  )
feat_links <- pb$links %>% filter(target_type %in% c("feature", "subfeature"))
notes$n_features <- as.integer(table(factor(feat_links$note_id, levels = notes$note_id)))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()))
LIME <- "#A8CC18"; INK <- "#111111"
pct  <- function(x) scales::percent(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), accuracy = 1)
kbl  <- function(d, ...) knitr::kable(d, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...)
```

`r if (CUSTOMERS_ONLY) paste0("**Existing customers only:** ", nrow(notes), " of ", N_ALL, " notes are tied to an account in op_list (", length(unique(notes$account_name)), " accounts). The other ", N_ALL - nrow(notes), " — prospects, partners, unmatched companies, or no customer — are excluded; set CUSTOMERS_ONLY <- FALSE to include them.") else ""`

Pulled `r format(pb$pulled_at, "%d %b %Y %H:%M")` · **`r nrow(notes)` notes** · `r nrow(pb$companies)` companies · `r nrow(pb$users)` users · `r nrow(pb$features)` features/subfeatures · account context from `r basename(sort(snaps, decreasing = TRUE)[1])`.

# 0. Pull health

Fill rate of each note field. Anything unexpectedly at 0% means the API returned that field under a different name than the connector reads — check that before trusting the sections below. Emails reading `[redacted]` mean the token lacks the `members:pii:read` scope.

```{r health}
fill <- notes %>%
  select(-tags) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(!is.na(.x) & as.character(.x) != ""))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "field", values_to = "filled") %>%
  arrange(filled)
kbl(fill %>% mutate(filled = scales::percent(filled, 1)))

red <- c(owner = mean(notes$owner_email %in% "[redacted]"), creator = mean(notes$creator_email %in% "[redacted]"))
if (any(red > 0)) cat("Redacted emails — owner:", scales::percent(red[["owner"]]), " creator:", scales::percent(red[["creator"]]), "\n")
```

# 1. Corpus overview

```{r overview}
tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Notes", "Date range", "Text / conversation / opportunity",
             "Processed", "Archived", "Linked to a customer (user or company)",
             "Resolved to a company", "Matched to an Immuta account",
             "Linked to ≥1 feature (a Productboard 'insight')", "Tagged"),
  Value = c(
    nrow(notes),
    paste(format(min(notes$created_date, na.rm = TRUE)), "to", format(max(notes$created_date, na.rm = TRUE))),
    paste(sum(notes$note_type %in% "textNote"), sum(notes$note_type %in% "conversationNote"),
          sum(notes$note_type %in% "opportunityNote"), sep = " / "),
    pct(notes$processed), pct(notes$archived), pct(notes$has_customer), pct(notes$has_company),
    pct(notes$has_account), pct(notes$n_features > 0), pct(!is.na(notes$tag_string))
  )
) %>% kbl()
```

**Source systems** (how notes got into Productboard):

```{r sources}
notes %>% count(source = coalesce(source_system, "(none / manual)"), sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(share = scales::percent(n / sum(n), 1)) %>% kbl()
```

**Top tags:**

```{r tags}
tibble::tibble(tag = unlist(notes$tags)) %>% count(tag, sort = TRUE) %>% head(25) %>% kbl()
```

# 2. Volume over time

```{r volume}
vol <- notes %>% filter(!is.na(fq)) %>%
  count(fq, source = coalesce(source_system, "manual")) %>%
  mutate(key = as.integer(substr(fq, 4, 7)) * 10 + as.integer(substr(fq, 2, 2)))
ggplot(vol, aes(reorder(fq, key), n, fill = source)) + geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Fiscal quarter created", y = "Notes", fill = NULL, title = "Notes created per fiscal quarter") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# 3. Who writes them

Creator = the Productboard member who created the note. "Is a CSM" is inferred by turning `first.last@immuta.com` into a name and matching it to the account report's Customer Success Manager list.

```{r writers}
csm_names <- unique(na.omit(as.character(accts$`Customer Success Manager`)))
email_name <- function(e) {
  n <- sub("@.*", "", e); n <- gsub("[._-]+", " ", n)
  tools::toTitleCase(trimws(n))
}
notes <- notes %>% mutate(
  creator_name = ifelse(is.na(creator_email) | creator_email == "[redacted]", NA, email_name(creator_email)),
  creator_is_csm = tolower(creator_name) %in% tolower(csm_names)
)
notes %>%
  group_by(creator = coalesce(creator_email, "(unknown)")) %>%
  summarise(notes = n(), is_csm = any(creator_is_csm), median_words = median(n_words),
            pct_linked_feature = pct(n_features > 0), pct_account = pct(has_account),
            last_note = max(created_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(notes)) %>% head(30) %>% kbl()
```

Share of notes written by CSMs: **`r pct(notes$creator_is_csm)`**. CSMs with no notes in the last 180 days:

```{r quiet-csms}
recent <- notes %>% filter(created_date >= TODAY - 180, creator_is_csm)
tibble::tibble(csm = csm_names) %>%
  mutate(notes_180d = vapply(tolower(csm), function(c) sum(tolower(recent$creator_name) == c), integer(1)),
         accounts   = vapply(csm, function(c) sum(accts$`Customer Success Manager` %in% c), integer(1))) %>%
  arrange(notes_180d, desc(accounts)) %>% kbl()
```

# 4. Content and quality

```{r length, fig.height=3.5}
ggplot(notes, aes(pmax(n_words, 1))) + geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = INK) +
  scale_x_log10() + labs(x = "Words in note body (log scale)", y = "Notes", title = "Note length")
```

```{r quality}
tibble::tibble(
  Check = c("Empty body", "Under 20 words", "20–100 words", "Over 100 words", "Over 300 words",
            "Exact-duplicate body text"),
  Share = c(pct(notes$n_words == 0), pct(notes$n_words > 0 & notes$n_words < 20),
            pct(notes$n_words >= 20 & notes$n_words <= 100), pct(notes$n_words > 100),
            pct(notes$n_words > 300),
            pct(duplicated(notes$content_text) & !is.na(notes$content_text)))
) %>% kbl()
```

# 5. Existing structure

How much of the corpus already carries structure a template could build on: bullets, headings, and `Label: value` lines. The label table is the most useful input for the new format — it shows what people already reach for when they structure a note.

```{r structure}
txt <- coalesce(notes$content_text, "")
html <- coalesce(notes$content_html, "")
label_rx <- "(?m)^\\s*(?:-\\s*)?\\**([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9 /&()'-]{1,40}?)\\**\\s*:\\s*\\S"
notes$n_labels  <- lengths(regmatches(txt, gregexpr(label_rx, txt, perl = TRUE)))
notes$has_bullets  <- grepl("(?m)^- ", txt, perl = TRUE)
notes$has_headings <- grepl("<h[1-6]|<b>|<strong>", html, ignore.case = TRUE)

tibble::tibble(
  Signal = c("Bulleted lists", "Headings / bold", "≥1 'Label: value' line", "≥3 'Label: value' lines"),
  Share  = c(pct(notes$has_bullets), pct(notes$has_headings), pct(notes$n_labels >= 1), pct(notes$n_labels >= 3))
) %>% kbl()
```

**Most common labels** (number of notes using each, case-folded):

```{r labels}
labs <- regmatches(txt, gregexpr(label_rx, txt, perl = TRUE))
lab_tbl <- tibble::tibble(note = rep(seq_along(labs), lengths(labs)), raw = unlist(labs)) %>%
  mutate(label = tolower(trimws(gsub("^\\s*-?\\s*\\**|\\**\\s*:.*$", "", raw)))) %>%
  distinct(note, label) %>% count(label, sort = TRUE)
kbl(head(lab_tbl, 40))
```

**Delivery-requirement language.** Share of notes using each family of words. A rough proxy for how often a note states something concrete the customer needs delivered.

```{r req-lang}
fam <- list(
  `Need / must / require`   = "\\b(must|need(s|ed)?|require(s|d|ment|ments)?|mandatory)\\b",
  `Blocker / gap`           = "\\b(block(er|ed|ing)?|gap|missing|cannot|can't|unable|limitation)\\b",
  `Date / deadline`         = "\\b(deadline|by (q[1-4]|end of|jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)|go[- ]live|timeline|due)\\b",
  `Renewal / commercial`    = "\\b(renewal|renew|churn|arr|contract|expansion|upsell|\\$[0-9])",
  `Workaround`              = "\\b(work ?around|manual(ly)?|custom script)\\b",
  `Use case`                = "\\buse[- ]cases?\\b",
  `Platform named`          = "\\b(snowflake|databricks|bigquery|redshift|starburst|trino|s3|azure|synapse|postgres|oracle|sql server|unity catalog)\\b"
)
low <- tolower(paste(coalesce(notes$title, ""), txt))
hits <- sapply(fam, function(rx) grepl(rx, low, perl = TRUE))
notes$req_families <- rowSums(hits)
tibble::tibble(Family = names(fam), Share = apply(hits, 2, pct)) %>% kbl()
```

`r pct(notes$req_families >= 3)` of notes hit three or more families. Those are the closest thing in the current corpus to a "substantive delivery requirement".

# 6. Themes

Most frequent words and two-word phrases in note titles and bodies (stopwords removed).

```{r themes}
stop <- c("the","a","an","and","or","to","of","in","on","for","with","is","are","was","were","be","been","it","its",
          "this","that","these","those","they","them","their","we","our","us","you","your","i","he","she","as","at",
          "by","from","but","not","no","so","if","then","than","there","here","have","has","had","do","does","did",
          "can","could","would","should","will","just","also","more","about","into","out","up","all","any","some",
          "what","which","who","when","how","want","like","get","use","using","via","re","etc","one","new")
tok <- function(s) { w <- strsplit(gsub("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ", s), "\\s+")[[1]]; w[nchar(w) > 2 & !w %in% stop] }
toks <- lapply(low, tok)
uni <- tibble::tibble(term = unlist(lapply(toks, unique))) %>% count(term, sort = TRUE) %>% head(30)
bi  <- tibble::tibble(term = unlist(lapply(toks, function(w) if (length(w) > 1) unique(paste(head(w, -1), tail(w, -1))) else character(0)))) %>%
  count(term, sort = TRUE) %>% head(30)
knitr::kables(list(kbl(uni, col.names = c("Word", "Notes")), kbl(bi, col.names = c("Phrase", "Notes"))))
```

# 7. Account coverage

```{r coverage}
acct_cov <- accts %>%
  transmute(account = `Account Name`, csm = `Customer Success Manager`, region = Region,
            arr = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Contract ARR Rollup`)),
            rating = vapply(product_adoption_rating, pbac_rating_colour, character(1))) %>%
  left_join(notes %>% filter(has_account) %>% group_by(account = account_name) %>%
              summarise(notes = n(), notes_180d = sum(created_date >= TODAY - 180, na.rm = TRUE),
                        last_note = max(created_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "account") %>%
  mutate(notes = coalesce(notes, 0L), notes_180d = coalesce(notes_180d, 0L))

tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Accounts with ≥1 note", "…in the last 180 days", "ARR covered by ≥1 note (180d)",
             "Black / Red accounts with a note (180d)"),
  Value  = c(pct(acct_cov$notes > 0), pct(acct_cov$notes_180d > 0),
             scales::percent(sum(acct_cov$arr[acct_cov$notes_180d > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(acct_cov$arr, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
             pct(acct_cov$notes_180d[acct_cov$rating %in% c("black", "red")] > 0))
) %>% kbl()
```

```{r coverage-plot, fig.height=5}
ggplot(acct_cov %>% filter(!is.na(arr)), aes(arr, notes + 1, colour = rating)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = .85) + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::dollar) + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(black = INK, red = "#DC2626", amber = "#F59E0B", green = "#22C55E"), na.value = "grey70") +
  labs(x = "Contract ARR (log)", y = "Notes + 1 (log)", colour = "Adoption", title = "Notes per account vs ARR")
```

**Largest accounts with no notes in the last 180 days:**

```{r silent}
acct_cov %>% filter(notes_180d == 0) %>% arrange(desc(arr)) %>% head(20) %>%
  mutate(arr = scales::dollar(arr)) %>% select(account, csm, region, rating, arr, notes, last_note) %>% kbl()
```

**Unmatched Productboard companies** (on notes but not matched to a Salesforce account, so excluded above — if any are real customers, fix the name in Productboard or the CRM sync):

```{r unmatched}
pb$unmatched_companies %>% head(30) %>% kbl()
```

# 8. Features

```{r features}
fr <- feat_links %>%
  left_join(notes %>% select(note_id, account_name), by = "note_id") %>%
  left_join(acct_cov %>% select(account, arr, rating), by = c("account_name" = "account")) %>%
  group_by(feature_id = target_id) %>%
  summarise(notes = n_distinct(note_id), accounts = n_distinct(na.omit(account_name)),
            arr_asking = sum(arr[!duplicated(account_name)], na.rm = TRUE),
            black_red_accounts = n_distinct(account_name[rating %in% c("black", "red")]), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(pb$features %>% select(feature_id = id, feature = name, type, status), by = "feature_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(arr_asking))
fr %>% head(30) %>% mutate(arr_asking = scales::dollar(arr_asking)) %>%
  select(feature, type, status, notes, accounts, arr_asking, black_red_accounts) %>% kbl()
```

# 9. Exemplars

The most structured notes (most `Label: value` lines) and the most requirement-like (most language families), for reference when drafting the template. Text is truncated to 600 characters.

```{r exemplars, results="asis"}
show <- function(d, heading) {
  cat("\n\n### ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    body <- substr(coalesce(d$content_text[i], ""), 1, 600)
    cat("**", coalesce(d$title[i], "(untitled)"), "** — ", coalesce(d$account_name[i], d$company_name[i], "no account"),
        " · ", coalesce(d$creator_email[i], "?"), " · ", format(d$created_date[i]),
        if (!is.na(d$html_url[i])) paste0(" · [open](", d$html_url[i], ")") else "", "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("<pre style='white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12px'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(body), "</pre>\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
show(notes %>% arrange(desc(n_labels), desc(n_words)) %>% head(8), "Most structured")
show(notes %>% filter(n_labels < 3) %>% arrange(desc(req_families), desc(n_words)) %>% head(8), "Most requirement-like, unstructured")
```

readr::write_csv(out, file.path(PROJ, "data", "productboard", paste0("notes_flat_", TODAY, ".csv")))
